nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why should companies not overlook the relationship between Social Identity Theory (SIT) and Theory of Planned Behaviour (TBP) in promoting good health and safety in developing nations?
nodes.answer: Companies should not overlook the relationship between SIT and TBP because it can improve Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 12 and contribute to creating long-term social value while minimizing costs.
